text: Gus climbed to the lamp room at noon. The first thing he checked was the clock.
A clock does not lose twelve seconds on its own. Somebody had stopped the pendulum, and started it again.
On the stairs, still damp, were footprints. Webbed ones.
Mabel, as usual, said nothing. Then she put her paw beside one.
Too big for a gull. Far too big. Those were a diver’s fins.
Someone had come up from the sea.
